{"id":"mimid-hcfn","title":"Accept AppDataUpdate before GCE in a Commit (ext #108)","description":"mlswg/mls-extensions PR #109 (merged 2026-11-01, closes #108) changed §4.7 'can be followed by zero or more AppDataUpdate proposals' to 'and zero or more AppDataUpdate proposals': list position of GroupContextExtensions vs AppDataUpdate is not an ordering rule; RFC 9420 §12.3 apply order covers it.

mimid rejects [AppDataUpdate, GroupContextExtensions] (found by code reading, not a test): the pinned OpenMLS fork (MarkAtwood/openmls c6291fe) returns AppDataUpdateValidationError::IncorrectOrder from PublicGroup::validate_app_data_update_proposals_and_group_context (openmls/src/group/public_group/validation.rs:730), called from stage_commit (staged_commit.rs:191) on every received Commit and from commit_builder.rs:786. Upstream openmls main has the same check (validation.rs:843). A conformant peer sending that order forks the group.

Do:
- Write a failing test first: a Commit with proposals [AppDataUpdate, GroupContextExtensions] produced by mls-rs (independent of OpenMLS), received by a mimid Member and an Observer; expect accept and matching epoch_authenticator. Extend crates/mimi-mls/tests/member_app_data_update.rs.
- Remove the ordering check in the fork (or rebase onto the upstream fix once the OpenMLS PR lands) and bump the pin.
